nav.title: Sēnita Fetuʻutaki AI
nav.subtitle: Tokoni ʻi he ngaahi lea lahi mo e tuku ki he tangata.

stats.providerQualification: Malavaʻi ʻa e tokotaha ʻo e tokoni
stats.providerQualificationNote: Ko e ngaahi lea kuo siviʻi pē ʻe kau ʻoku lau

customer.title: Kamata ha fetalanoaʻaki
customer.consentText: ʻOku ou loto ki ai ʻe lava ke ngāueʻaki ʻe he tokotaha AI ʻa e fetalanoaʻaki ni. ʻOku fakapulí e ngaahi tohi kimuʻa pea tauhi.
customer.startVoice: Kamata e leʻo ʻi he palausa
customer.setupHint: ʻOku ʻikai maʻu kae ʻoua kuo fokotuʻu ʻe he pule e kī mo e tokotaha AI.
customer.startHint: Fai ha sēsoni mo e fakangofua ke kamata.
customer.chatEmpty: ʻOku hā e ngaahi pōpoaki ʻi heni. Ko e ngaahi ngāue AI ko e faleʻi pē; ʻoku ʻikai fai ha totongi pe liliu ʻo e ʻakauni.
customer.voiceStreamNote: ʻOku ʻave e leʻo ʻo e palausa ki he tokotaha; ʻoku ʻikai pehē ʻe OpsCore ʻoku tauhi e leʻo moʻoni.
customer.voiceRequirement: ʻOku fiemaʻu e leʻo ʻo e palausa ʻa e HTTPS, maikolofoni, fakangofua, faʻunga Realtime mo e kī. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha telefoni PSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Laine ʻo e tuku
queue.description: ʻOku hā ʻi heni e ngaahi fetalanoaʻaki fakatuʻutāmaki, ʻikai keʻosi, pe kole ʻe ha tangata. Ko e laine ko ha kole, ʻoku ʻikai ko ha fehokotaki.
queue.empty: ʻOku ʻikai ha tuku ki he kakai ʻi he kautaha ni.
queue.replyStorageNote: ʻOku fakapulí e ngaahi tali ʻa e kakai pea hā ʻi he tohi ʻo e fetalanoaʻaki.
queue.resolveNote: Kuo ʻosi ʻe he tokotaha ngāue kuo vahe.

boundaries.title: Ngaahi kau ʻo e ngāue
boundaries.automateBody: Tali ʻuluaki ʻi he ngaahi lea lahi, fakamatala, sivi ʻo e fakatuʻutāmaki, tauhi ʻo e tohi mo e fokotuʻu ʻo e laine.
boundaries.humanTitle: ʻOku fiemaʻu e tokoni ʻa ha tangata
boundaries.humanBody: Kole ʻa e tangata, tui siʻisiʻi, fakatuʻutāmaki lahi, ʻikai ha lao, meʻa ʻoku teʻeki keʻosi, kōketi fakapulipuli.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: ʻOku ʻikai lava ʻe he pakití ni pē
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, ʻīmeli, telefoni, CRM mo e fakamoʻoni ʻo e lea ʻoku fiemaʻu ha tokotaha moʻoni mo e ngaahi sivi.

handoffReasons.customer_requested_human: Naʻe kole e kasi ha tangata
handoffReasons.model_requested: Naʻe kole e AI ha sivi
handoffReasons.voice_review_required: ʻOku fiemaʻu e sivi ʻo e leʻo

messages.qualificationNotice: ʻOku ʻikai ha lea kuo fakamoʻoniʻi kae ʻoua kuo ʻosi e ngaahi sivi ʻo e tohi, ASR, TTS mo e leʻo.
messages.configOk: ʻOku ʻi ai e fokotuʻu. ʻOku fiemaʻu e sivi moʻoni ki he fehokotaki mo e lelei ʻo e lea.
messages.conversationCreated: Kuo fai ha fetalanoaʻaki malu. ʻOku teʻeki fakamoʻoniʻi e lelei ʻo e lea.
messages.handoffQueued: Kuo tuku ki he laine ({reason}). Ko ha kole, ʻoku ʻikai ko ha fehokotaki.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Naʻe ʻikai keʻosi e tali ʻa e AI. ʻOku ʻikai ha ngāue naʻe fai. ʻE lava ke ke kole ha tangata.
messages.apiUnavailable: Naʻe ʻikai lava ʻo hiki e API. Hū ki OpsCore, pea fakaʻoutoutou e peesi ni.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Kuo tuku ki he laine ({reason}). ʻOku ʻikai fakamoʻoniʻi ʻe he laine ʻoku fehokotaki ha tokotaha ngāue.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Kuo tuku ki he laine. ʻOku taʻofi e fetalanoaʻaki AI; ʻoku teʻeki fokotuʻu e telefoni moʻui.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: ʻOku kole ha kī leʻo mo taimi nounou…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Naʻe lipooti ʻe he tokotaha Realtime ha hala. Taʻofi e leʻo, sivi e fokotuʻu, pea toe feinga.
messages.voiceActive: ʻOku ngāue e leʻo. Lomiʻi e “Request human” ʻi ha taimi; ʻoku fai ha laine, ʻoku ʻikai ko ha telefoni PSTN.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: ʻOku fiemaʻu e fakangofua kimuʻa pea kamata ha fetalanoaʻaki.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Naʻe ʻikai lava ʻo lau e tali ʻa e sēvā.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Naʻe ʻikai maʻu e tokotaha leʻo Realtime.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: ʻOku ʻikai poupouʻi ʻe he palausa ni e leʻo Realtime.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE: Kuo tuku kehe e pōpoaki tuʻo ua.
